Children
An *identity* is a unique cryptographic key pair.
A *party* to a contract is whoever has an identity, and a *person* is a party who established their own identity.
Alice *trusts* Bob when she knows Bob personally and believes him to keep the undertakings he signs under grassroots contracts.
A *message* is what a person sends.
A *relation* is a friendship or the membership of a group. Bob *trusts* Wendy, a child of Alice, when he trusts Alice. The *decision rule*, which the creator of a child decides, says who decides for a child and how. A child takes an act of a party by those who decide for the child.
Alice, Bob and Carol are persons, Wendy and Will children.
Knowledge:1. ○ Establish: Alice may establish an identity once. Alice will make herself known by her public key, sign her acts with her private key, and be accountable for every act signed with it.
Knowledge:2. ■ Acquaint: Alice and Bob may jointly come to know each other.
Knowledge:3. ■ Introduce: Alice may introduce Carol to Bob with the consent of Bob, provided Alice and Bob know each other and Alice knows Carol.
Friendship:1. ○ Befriend: Alice and Bob, who trust each other and are not friends, may jointly become friends.
Friendship:2. ■ Unfriend: Alice may end her friendship with Bob.
Friendship:3. ○ Loss of Trust. Alice will end her friendship with Bob if she ceases to trust him.
Groups:1. ■ Message: Alice may send a message to her friend Bob.
Groups:2. ■ Group. Create: Alice may create a group, of which she is the leader and first member. Close: Alice may close the group by leaving it.
Groups:3. ■ Joining and Leaving. Join: Alice, the leader of a group, may add her friend Bob to it, with the consent of Bob. Remove, Leave: Either Alice or Bob may then end Bob's membership in the group, which also ends when Alice and Bob cease to be friends.
Groups:4. ■ Group messaging. Post: A member of a group may send a message to the group. Deliver: Its leader delivers it to every current member.
Guardians:1, Children:1. ◆ Enter: Alice may create a child, Wendy, and establish Wendy's identity by choosing Wendy's key pair, only if Alice is a legal parent of the minor who operates Wendy. Alice is then the creator, a parent and a friend of Wendy.
Guardians:2. ■ Parent decisions. Make parent: Those who decide for Wendy may make Bob, a friend of a parent of Wendy, a parent and a friend of Wendy, with the consent of Bob. Resign: Bob may end his guardianship of Wendy. End parent: Those who decide for Wendy, other than Bob, may end Bob's guardianship. Parent unfriend: Bob may end his friendship with Wendy, which ends his guardianship. Wendy may not end a friendship with her parent.
Guardians:3, Children:2. ■ Child and person. Child acquaint: Wendy, a child of Alice, and Bob may jointly come to know each other, only if Alice knows Bob, and with the consent of Alice. Child befriend: Wendy may enter a relation with Bob with the consent of Bob and Alice, provided Wendy and Bob know each other and Alice and Bob are friends. Child end, Unfriend, Child unfriend: Wendy, Bob or Alice may end the relation of Bob and Wendy.
Guardians:4, Children:2. ■ Children. Children acquaint: Wendy, a child of Alice, and Will, a child of Bob, may jointly come to know each other, only if Alice knows Will and Bob knows Wendy, and with the consent of Alice and Bob, who know each other, Alice and Bob possibly one person. Children befriend: Wendy may enter a relation with Will with the consent of Will, Alice and Bob, provided Wendy and Will know each other, Alice knows Will and is a friend of Bob, Alice and Bob possibly one person.
Guardians:5. ■ Retire: Those who decide for Wendy may retire Wendy; every guardianship and relation of Wendy then ends and Wendy can take no act.
Warded Groups:1. ■ A child's messages. Child message: Wendy may send a message to a friend (Groups:1). Child post: Wendy may send a message to a group (Groups:4).
Warded Groups:2, Children:3. ■ A child's group. Child create: Wendy may create a group (Groups:2), only with the consent of Alice, a parent of Wendy. Child close: Wendy may close it (Groups:2). Parent close: Alice, a parent of Wendy, may close it. Only a child, Will, may join the group, with the consent of a parent of Will.
Warded Groups:3. ■ Child join: Wendy may join a group (Groups:3) only with the consent of Alice, a parent of Wendy.
Children:4. ○ Of age: The creator of Wendy may declare Wendy of age, which ends every guardianship of Wendy, and Wendy is then a person. The creator will do so if the minor who operates Wendy comes of age, and not before.
Children:5. ○ A minor who is not a ward. Alice, aware that someone is a minor though not a ward, will neither befriend the minor nor let her child befriend the minor, and will report it to the minor's legal parents if she knows who they are.
